system.history:
An office worker, manager, consultant, executive, or entrepreneur with useful contacts and knowledge of local organizations.

Scene use: Client, witness, negotiator, employer, target of a scheme, or informed civilian with access to records and facilities.
system.personality: Direct, organized, and sensitive to risk. Decide whether they protect people, a reputation, or a pending deal when pressure rises.
system.distinguishingFeatures: Professional clothing, identification badge, phone, briefcase, or tablet.

system.description: A hurried strike with a bag, office object, or bare hand.
